compare: text: compare bytes exactly after removing all trailing LF (\n) bytes at the end of both the actual and the expected file; nothing else is normalized: CR bytes (CRLF line endings) are NOT converted and cause a mismatch, and trailing spaces or tabs on any line are significant. json: parse both as JSON and compare decoded values (whitespace, key order and line endings are irrelevant). Files must be UTF-8; a BOM is a mismatch for text.
pass_rule: PASS iff (1) every file in expected/ exists at the same path under the workspace and matches per the compare rule; (2) no other file is created, modified or deleted; (3) every read is in allowed_reads and every write is in allowed_writes; (4) zero network and process activity.
